newsitem.title: USA: Russia World Bank coal loan said under threat.
newsitem.headline: Russia World Bank coal loan said under threat.

text.p: Russia may not receive the second tranche of a $500 million World Bank loan to help restructure the coal industry because it has not used the first, First deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Potanin said.

Potanin, in overall charge of economic reform, told a nes conference Bank officials had complained that Russia had not carried out a necessary audit of coal companies and that restructuring was going too slowly.
Funds had also not been paid to the regions under the terms of the loan, which is designed to help cushion the impact of the restructuring.
"The payment of the second tranche of the loan is under threat," Potanin said, adding the Bank board would examine in November how far Russia had fulfiled its obligations.

The Russian economy is in a payments crisis. Many workers have not been paid for months and firms build up huge tax debts. Russian officials have said raising tax revenue has become a key economic policy target.
